name: fairies exi(s)t
source:
You wake up in complete darkness. Standing before you is a girl who says she’s leaving you. You have no memory of who she is, but you feel that this stranger is important to you. She agrees to guide you through the memories you once shared. 

The words “Goodbye” (ru:"Прощай") and “Wait” (ru:"Постой") have the same number of letters.
So… what will you say to Karen Smith?
translation:
你在完全黑暗中醒来。站在你面前的是一个女孩，她说她要离开你了。你不记得她是谁，但你觉得这个陌生人对你很重要。她同意引导你回忆你们曾经分享的回忆。

“再见”（ru：“Прощай”）和“等待”（ru：“Постой”）的字母数量相同。
那么……你会对凯伦·史密斯说什么？
